children.value: Vorbis comment vendor string "reference libFLAC 1.5.0 20250211", the form libFLAC writes

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The block size is 4,096 samples in every frame but the last; levels 3 to 8 use it.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The highest linear predictor order is 12; 23 of 26 subframes are linear predictors.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: 4 of 13 frames code the channels as left/side, side/right or mid/side, which levels 0 and 3 never do.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Levels 7 or 8 set a highest linear predictor order of 12, a highest partition order of 6 and a block size of 4,096 samples.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Every level the frames fit sets the same figures: the frames exceed the limits of all the others, or, with two channels, their stereo coding rules the others out.
